findings.note: SC-002 bars conditional outcomes as approval but does not test the required sequence in FR-007: conditions are addressed, then the owner records explicit approval before application. Add that condition to the measurable outcome so a conditional review cannot satisfy it by itself.

SC-004 omits FR-006's case where the last review point or source status cannot be established. Add an observable outcome for recording that uncertainty and requesting owner revalidation; otherwise the success criteria do not cover a required stale-baseline edge case.

FR-006 requires the baseline record to identify its review point, but does not state what minimally makes that point identifiable. A date or source revision would make the since-review staleness test auditable and consistent across reviewers; without a minimum, compliance may be interpreted inconsistently.

No success criterion verifies FR-010's explicit refactor boundary that existing docs/architecture diagram files remain unchanged. Add an observable scope check so guidance-only changes cannot pass while a shared diagram was altered.

The checklist marks all requirements testable and all outcomes measurable, while SC-002 and SC-004 do not fully cover the conditional-approval and unknown-review/source-status cases required by FR-007 and FR-006. Reconcile these checklist claims with the success-criteria gaps before treating the checklist as evidence of completeness.
